rationale: All four of my round-1 concrete asks are ADDRESSED in the 8a13b898 text, re-derived against the tree (classifications below), and the fix-author resolutions I audited hold: the OQ-3 option-3 audit bar correctly names the spec-114 audited-refutation mechanism as the only admission path (I endorse it), and the #255 narrowing produces a crisp exactly-one-owner boundary (filter-caused silence moves in via R6.3/AC-10/AC-10b; the readiness-truth consumption face stays with 129 — the double-disclaim seam is closed). Charter fidelity remains sound after the fix: the settled-fact-6 rewrite reconciles the charter's {"mode":""} claim with the same-day idle observations via a reproduced bd-availability discriminator, which is the charter's own re-verify mandate honored rather than a relitigation, and R5.1's guard removal is the charter-sanctioned 'rebuild or drop' arm with a re-arm mechanism. However, the round-1 G7 row additions introduced a NEW internal-consistency defect in R1.3 that the G4 carve-out was created to prevent: the 'release → plan (no sibling closed)' row asserts three-surface agreement on plan, but I re-derived that release syncs mindspec_phase via the stored-trusting DerivePhase (cmd/mindspec/release.go:315-318 → internal/phase/derive.go:174-193, 'trusting stored phase'), so the post-release all-open state keeps stored implement against child-derived plan — under BOTH live OQ-3 arms (option 1 advances stored to implement at first claim; option 2 writes it at plan approve), making the row's asserted agreement unsatisfiable exactly like the pre-fix plan-approve row. One targeted change; hence REQUEST_CHANGES without hard_block.
concrete_changes_required: R1.3: extend the plan-approve row's OQ-3 carve-out to the 'release → plan (no sibling closed)' row (or condition that row on the same design decision). Derived at the reviewed commit: release's step-6.5 sync calls phase.DerivePhase (release.go:315-318), which is stored-trusting (derive.go:174-193) — so releasing the sole claimed bead back to all-open leaves stored implement vs child-derived plan under both OQ-3 options (option 1 advances stored to implement at the first claim; option 2 wrote it at plan approve), and the row's three-surface agreement on plan is unsatisfiable without either the carve-out annotation or an explicit requirement redesigning release's phase sync. As a rider, note in R3.1/R3.2 that this release-produced state is a second deterministic reproduction route into the #248 warning window (release's own DerivePhase call emits the repair-phase hint on the disagreement it just preserved), so the R3 fixture's coverage statement includes it rather than being plan-approve-shaped only.

findings.title: NEW_ISSUE: 'release → plan' agreement-table row is unsatisfiable under the stored-trusting derivation — G4 carve-out not propagated to the G7 row additions
findings.detail: R1.3's new row 'release → plan (no sibling closed — ADR-0023.md:142)' asserts state show, the instruct tail, and the derivation agree on plan after release returns the epic to all-children-open. Re-derived at 8a13b898: release syncs mindspec_phase with phase.DerivePhase (release.go:311-318, 'mirror complete.go step 6.5'), and DerivePhase routes to DerivePhaseWithStatusWithCache, which returns the STORED phase on disagreement while emitting the #248 warning (derive.go:174-193). At release time stored is implement under both OQ-3 arms, so the sync writes implement back and the mode-reporting surfaces (stored-first per spec 080) report implement while DerivePhaseFromChildren over the all-open child set yields plan — the exact stored-leads-derived disagreement the fix's own plan-approve carve-out exists for, granted only to the plan-approve row. AC-2's fixture for this row is therefore unsatisfiable as specified, which would force a false fixture or a silent OQ-3-adjacent design decision at implementation time. Additionally, release's own DerivePhase call on this state emits the 'recovery: mindspec repair phase' hint — a second deterministic reproduction of the #248 self-worsening-hint window that R3's plan-approve-shaped fixture narrative does not name.
